import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_NODES = 10;
    static final int MODULUS_VALUE = 1000000007;

    static class Modular {
        long v;

        Modular(long val) {
            v = val % MODULUS_VALUE;
            if (v < 0) v += MODULUS_VALUE;
        }

        static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >> 31);
        }

        static long seed;

        static {
            Random rand = new Random();
            seed = splitmix64(System.nanoTime() + rand.nextLong());
        }

        static long getRandomPointer() {
            return splitmix64(System.nanoTime() + new Random().nextLong());
        }

        static long getSeed() {
            return seed;
        }

        Modular add(Modular other) {
            long res = v + other.v;
            if (res >= MODULUS_VALUE) res -= MODULUS_VALUE;
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        Modular subtract(Modular other) {
            long res = v - other.v;
            if (res < 0) res += MODULUS_VALUE;
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        Modular multiply(Modular other) {
            long res = (v * other.v) % MODULUS_VALUE;
            return new Modular(res);
        }

        static long modInverse(long a) {
            return modInv(a, MODULUS_VALUE);
        }

        static long modInv(long a, long m) {
            long m0 = m, t, q;
            long x0 = 0, x1 = 1;
            if (m == 1) return 0;
            while (a > 1) {
                q = a / m;
                t = m;
                m = a % m;
                a = t;
                t = x0;
                x0 = x1 - q * x0;
                x1 = t;
            }
            if (x1 < 0) x1 += m0;
            return x1;
        }

        Modular divide(Modular other) {
            return this.multiply(new Modular(modInverse(other.v)));
        }

        Modular pow(long p) {
            assert p >= 0;
            Modular result = new Modular(1);
            Modular base = this;
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1) result = result.multiply(base);
                base = base.multiply(base);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(v);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int total_Ns = sc.nextInt();

        Modular[][] prob_mat = new Modular[total_Ns][total_Ns];
        for (int i = 0; i < total_Ns; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < total_Ns; j++) {
                int p = sc.nextInt();
                prob_mat[i][j] = new Modular(p).divide(new Modular(100));
            }
        }

        List<List<Integer>> masks_by_count = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= total_Ns; i++) {
            masks_by_count.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] lookup_idx = new int[1 << total_Ns];
        Arrays.fill(lookup_idx, -1);
        for (int m = 0; m < (1 << total_Ns); m++) {
            int c = Integer.bitCount(m);
            lookup_idx[m] = masks_by_count.get(c).size();
            masks_by_count.get(c).add(m);
        }

        Map<Long, Modular> possible_states_map = new HashMap<>();
        long initial_mask = 1L << lookup_idx[0];
        possible_states_map.put(initial_mask, new Modular(1));

        for (int left_part = 0; left_part < total_Ns; left_part++) {
            Map<Long, Modular> new_states_map = new HashMap<>();
            Modular[] product_mask_vec = new Modular[1 << total_Ns];
            Arrays.fill(product_mask_vec, new Modular(1));
            for (int current_mask = 0; current_mask < (1 << total_Ns); current_mask++) {
                Modular prod = new Modular(1);
                for (int r = 0; r < total_Ns; r++) {
                    if (((current_mask >> r) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.multiply(prob_mat[left_part][r]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.multiply(new Modular(1).subtract(prob_mat[left_part][r]));
                    }
                }
                product_mask_vec[current_mask] = prod;
            }

            long[] new_bits_vec = new long[total_Ns];
            Modular[] new_possible_mask_vec = new Modular[1 << total_Ns];
            Arrays.fill(new_possible_mask_vec, new Modular(0));

            for (Map.Entry<Long, Modular> state : possible_states_map.entrySet()) {
                long current_mask_state = state.getKey();
                Modular prob_value = state.getValue();

                Arrays.fill(new_bits_vec, 0);
                for (int m : masks_by_count.get(left_part)) {
                    if (((current_mask_state >> lookup_idx[m]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < total_Ns; i++) {
                            if (((m >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                long new_mask = 1L << lookup_idx[m | (1 << i)];
                                new_bits_vec[i] |= new_mask;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Arrays.fill(new_possible_mask_vec, new Modular(0));
                for (int curr_mask = 1; curr_mask < (1 << total_Ns); curr_mask++) {
                    long prev_mask = curr_mask & (curr_mask - 1);
                    int ctz = Long.numberOfTrailingZeros(curr_mask);
                    new_possible_mask_vec[curr_mask] = new_possible_mask_vec[(int) prev_mask].add(new Modular(new_bits_vec[ctz]));
                    Modular val = prob_value.multiply(product_mask_vec[curr_mask]);
                    new_possible_mask_vec[curr_mask] = new_possible_mask_vec[curr_mask].add(val);
                }

                for (int m = 1; m < (1 << total_Ns); m++) {
                    long mask_value = new_possible_mask_vec[m].v;
                    new_states_map.put(mask_value, new_states_map.getOrDefault(mask_value, new Modular(0)).add(new_possible_mask_vec[m]));
                }
            }
            possible_states_map = new_states_map;
        }

        Modular total_res = new Modular(0);
        int last_bit = lookup_idx[(1 << total_Ns) - 1];
        for (Map.Entry<Long, Modular> state : possible_states_map.entrySet()) {
            if (((state.getKey() >> last_bit) & 1) == 1) {
                total_res = total_res.add(state.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total_res.v);
    }
}
